Re: Offer of Employment — Staff Mechanical Engineer

Dear Oluwaseun,

We are delighted to offer you the position of Staff Mechanical Engineer at Thistledown Robotics, Inc. (the "Company"). This letter sets out the terms of the offer.

1. Position and Start Date. You will be a Staff Mechanical Engineer reporting to Priyanka Venkataraman, VP of Hardware. Your anticipated start date is September 14, 2026. This is a full-time, exempt position based at our Seattle office, with the hybrid schedule described in the employee handbook.

2. Base Salary. Your annual base salary will be $214,000, paid semi-monthly in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings. Your salary will be reviewed annually; a review does not guarantee an increase.

3. Annual Bonus. You will be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 12% of your base salary, prorated for your first partial year. Whether a bonus is paid, and in what amount, is determined by the Board in its discretion based on Company and individual performance. You must be employed on the payment date to receive a bonus.

4. Equity. Subject to approval by the Board, you will be granted an option to purchase 42,000 shares of the Company's common stock at an exercise price equal to the fair market value on the grant date as determined by the Board. The option will vest over four years, with 25% vesting on the first anniversary of your vesting commencement date and the remainder vesting in equal monthly installments over the following 36 months, subject to your continued service. The option is governed in all respects by the Company's 2024 Equity Incentive Plan and your grant agreement, which control over any description in this letter. The post-termination exercise period is 90 days.

5. Benefits. You will be eligible for the Company's benefit plans on the terms and eligibility rules of each plan, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and flexible paid time off. Washington Paid Family and Medical Leave and Seattle Paid Sick and Safe Time apply as required by law. The Company may change or end any benefit plan at any time.

6. At-Will Employment. Your employment with the Company is at will. Either you or the Company may end the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause and with or without notice. Nothing in this letter, in the handbook, or in any Company practice creates a contract of employment for a fixed term or a promise of continued employment. Only the Chief Executive Officer may change the at-will nature of your employment, and only in a writing signed by the CEO.

7. Confidentiality and Inventions. As a condition of employment, you must sign the Company's Employee Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement, enclosed. Under RCW 49.44.140, that agreement does not apply to an invention you develop entirely on your own time without using the Company's equipment, supplies, facilities, or trade secret information, except for an invention that relates to the Company's business or actual or demonstrably anticipated research or development, or that results from work you performed for the Company.

8. No Conflicting Obligations. By accepting this offer you confirm that you are not subject to any agreement that would prevent you from performing this role, and that you will not use or bring to the Company any confidential information belonging to a former employer.

9. Non-Solicitation. For twelve months after your employment ends, you agree not to solicit any Company employee to leave the Company. The Company is not asking you to agree to any noncompetition covenant, and none is a condition of this offer.

10. Work Authorization. This offer is contingent on your completing Form I-9 and providing documentation establishing your identity and authorization to work in the United States within three business days of your start date.

11. Background Check. This offer is contingent on a background check satisfactory to the Company, conducted in accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and Washington law, and on your receipt of the separate disclosure and authorization forms we will send you before it begins.

12. Dispute Resolution. Any dispute arising out of or relating to your employment will be resolved by binding arbitration in Seattle, Washington, before a single arbitrator under the JAMS Employment Arbitration Rules. The Company will pay all arbitration fees in excess of what you would pay to file in court. This paragraph does not cover a claim of sexual harassment or sexual assault, which you may bring in court under 9 U.S.C. §§ 401-402, and does not prevent you from filing a charge with an administrative agency or from participating in an agency investigation.

13. Entire Agreement. This letter, together with the agreements it refers to, is the entire agreement between you and the Company about your employment and supersedes any earlier discussion, offer, or representation, whether oral or written.

This offer expires on August 10, 2026. To accept, sign below and return a copy to people@thistledownrobotics.com.

We are excited about what you will build here.

Sincerely,

/s/ Marguerite Oyelowo-Brandt
Marguerite Oyelowo-Brandt
Chief People Officer
Thistledown Robotics, Inc.

ACCEPTED AND AGREED:

/s/ Oluwaseun Adeyemi-Karlsson
